## VENOM CODE — Quality and security review

- [ ] Acceptance criteria and expected behavior documented
- [ ] Scoped changes inspected and unrelated regressions avoided
- [ ] Mobile, desktop and accessibility validated
- [ ] Forms, UX errors/loading/empty states and APIs tested where relevant
- [ ] Existing lint/TypeScript/build/flow checks executed with evidence
- [ ] Authentication, API, secrets and dependency risks reviewed
- [ ] CodeQL findings triaged when supported
- [ ] Preview verified; any dynamic pentest performed only within expressly authorized scope
- [ ] Risks, NOT TESTED areas and rollback documented
- [ ] Human approves before merging to main or deploying to production
